s: June 26, 2023 - Of course, you need at least one male and one female, but apistos can sometimes be hard to sex at the fish store because subdominant males can hide their colors to look like a female and avoid the ire of the dominant male. Then once you bring them home, the “sneaker male” colors up and you realize you have no females at all. In our experience, we’ve had good success buying a group of apistogrammas and letting them form spawning pairs amongst themselves.
